There are many office furniture brands, ranging from budget-friendly to high-end, and catering to various design aesthetics and functional needs. Here's a breakdown of some of the most popular and respected office furniture brand websites, categorized for easier navigation:

**Luxury & High-End Brands (Focus on Design, Ergonomics, and Quality):**

*   **Herman Miller:** [https://www.hermanmiller.com/](https://www.hermanmiller.com/) (Iconic designs like the Aeron chair, known for ergonomics and timeless style.)
*   **Steelcase:** [https://www.steelcase.com/](https://www.steelcase.com/) (Another leader in ergonomic seating and innovative workplace solutions, including tables, storage, and architectural products.)
*   **Knoll:** [https://www.knoll.com/](https://www.knoll.com/) (Known for modern design, often featuring collaborations with famous designers. Part of MillerKnoll now.)
*   **Haworth:** [https://www.haworth.com/](https://www.haworth.com/) (Global office furniture manufacturer focusing on adaptable spaces, well-being, and sustainable solutions.)
*   **Gensler (though they are designers, they often feature specific furniture brands):** [https://www.gensler.com/](https://www.gensler.com/) (While not an office furniture manufacturer themselves, Gensler is a leading architecture and design firm that heavily influences the office furniture market and often showcases specific brands in their projects.)

**Mid-Range to Upper Mid-Range Brands (Good Balance of Quality, Design, and Value):**

*   **Humanscale:** [https://www.humanscale.com/](https://www.humanscale.com/) (Specializes in ergonomic tools and task seating, particularly strong in monitor arms and chairs.)
*   **Kimball International:** [https://www.kimballinternational.com/](https://www.kimballinternational.com/) (Offers a broad range of office furniture solutions, including seating, desks, and storage, with a focus on design and functionality.)
*   **Allsteel:** [https://www.allsteeloffice.com/](https://www.allsteeloffice.com/) (Provides comprehensive office solutions from seating to collaborative spaces, known for durability.)
*   **Teknion:** [https://teknion.com/](https://teknion.com/) (Offers a wide range of office systems, seating, storage, and tables, with a modern aesthetic.)
*   **SitOnIt Seating:** [https://www.sitonit.com/](https://www.sitonit.com/) (Focuses primarily on a wide variety of office chairs, offering customizable options at competitive prices.)
*   **Hon:** [https://www.hon.com/](https://www.hon.com/) (Popular for reliable and practical office furniture, often found in government and corporate settings.)
*   **Indiana Furniture:** [https://www.indianafurniture.com/](https://www.indianafurniture.com/) (Offers a diverse portfolio of desking, seating, and storage, manufactured in the USA.)

**Direct-to-Consumer & Online-Focused Brands (Often Good Value and Convenience):**

*   **Fully (now part of Knoll):** [https://www.fully.com/](https://www.fully.com/) (Popular for standing desks, ergonomic chairs, and accessories, known for stylish and functional products.)
*   **UPLIFT Desk:** [https://www.upliftdesk.com/](https://www.upliftdesk.com/) (Known for its highly customizable standing desks and ergonomic accessories.)
*   **Branch Furniture:** [https://www.branchfurniture.com/](https://www.branchfurniture.com/) (Offers modern, affordable office furniture designed for startups and growing teams, with a focus on simplicity and value.)
*   **Autonomous AI:** [https://www.autonomous.ai/](https://www.autonomous.ai/) (Known for smart office furniture, particularly standing desks and ergonomic chairs, often at competitive prices.)
*   **FlexiSpot:** [https://flexispot.com/](https://flexispot.com/) (Another popular brand for standing desks, desk converters, and ergonomic chairs, often with good value.)
*   **IKEA:** [https://www.ikea.com/](https://www.ikea.com/) (While not exclusively office furniture, IKEA offers a vast range of affordable and stylish office solutions suitable for home offices and small businesses.)

**Specialty & Niche Brands:**

*   **ergoCentric Seating Systems:** [https://ergocentric.com/](https://ergocentric.com/) (Specializes in highly ergonomic and customizable seating, often used in healthcare and specialized work environments.)
*   **Safco Products:** [https://www.safcoproducts.com/](https://www.safcoproducts.com/) (Offers a broad range of office products beyond just furniture, including organization, facility, and storage solutions.)

**Tips for Browsing:**

*   **Consider your budget:** Brands like Herman Miller and Steelcase are premium, while IKEA, Branch, and Autonomous offer more budget-friendly options.
*   **Think about your needs:** Do you need a full office system, just a chair, or a standing desk?
*   **Look at reviews:** Read reviews for specific products, especially chairs, as comfort is highly subjective.
*   **Check for certifications:** Look for BIFMA certification for commercial furniture standards.
*   **Sustainability:** Many brands now highlight their efforts in sustainable manufacturing and materials.

This list should give you a comprehensive starting point for exploring the world of office furniture brands!
